name: Identity Prompting CLI Integration
description: Add --resolve-identities flag to the CLI (cli/ entry point). When flag is passed and unknowns exist, present interactive prompts: 'Who is @handle? Best match: john.smith (0.87). Confirm? [y/n/other]'. Process user responses and persist confirmed mappings via AliasStore. In non-interactive mode (default, or CI): log unknowns and suggestions as warnings, write to a YAML file for later resolution. Auto-prompt when unknowns exceed a configurable threshold. Supports graceful Ctrl+C handling with partial progress persistence.

types.description: UTF-8 string

types.name: int
types.description: Integer

types.description: IEEE 754 double-precision floating point

types.name: bool
types.description: Boolean true/false

types.name: UnknownIdentifier

fields.name: handle

fields.name: source

fields.name: first_seen
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the first occurrence of this unknown identifier.

fields.name: occurrence_count
fields.description: Total number of times this identifier has been encountered across all sources.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model representing an identifier the resolver could not map to a known person. Immutable after creation.

types.name: EvidenceList
types.description: List of human-readable evidence strings supporting a match suggestion.

types.name: MatchSuggestion

fields.name: candidate_person_id
fields.description: The unique person identifier of the suggested match from the identity store.

validators.error_message: candidate_person_id must be non-empty and at most 256 characters

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Confidence score for this match, from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (certain match).

validators.error_message: confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: List of human-readable strings explaining why this candidate was suggested (e.g. 'email prefix matches', 'GitHub username overlap').

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model representing a candidate match for an unknown identifier, with confidence score and supporting evidence.

types.name: MatchSuggestionList
types.description: Ordered list of match suggestions, sorted by descending confidence.

types.name: ResolutionAction
types.description: The action taken by the user or system when resolving an unknown identifier.

types.name: OptionalStr
types.description: An optional string value, present or null.

types.name: ResolutionDecision

fields.name: unknown
fields.description: The unknown identifier this decision pertains to.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The resolution action taken: confirm (accept suggestion), reject (discard suggestion), skip (defer for later), manual (user supplied a different person_id).

fields.name: resolved_person_id
fields.description: The person_id the unknown was resolved to. Required when action is 'confirm' or 'manual'. Must be null when action is 'reject' or 'skip'.

fields.name: matched_suggestion
fields.description: The MatchSuggestion that was confirmed, if action is 'confirm'. Null for other actions.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this decision was made.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model capturing the decision made for a single unknown identifier resolution attempt.

types.name: OptionalMatchSuggestion
types.description: An optional MatchSuggestion, present when a suggestion was confirmed.

types.name: ResolutionDecisionList
types.description: List of resolution decisions made during a resolution session.

types.name: UnknownIdentifierList

types.name: ResolutionReport

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version for this report format, enabling forward-compatible YAML deserialization.

fields.name: decisions
fields.description: All resolution decisions made during this session (confirm, reject, skip, manual).

fields.name: unresolved
fields.description: Identifiers that remain unresolved after this session (skipped or not yet processed due to interruption).

fields.name: auto_confirmed
fields.description: Count of identifiers auto-confirmed because suggestion confidence exceeded auto_confirm_threshold.

fields.name: user_confirmed
fields.description: Count of identifiers explicitly confirmed by the user via interactive prompt.

fields.name: total_processed
fields.description: Total number of unknown identifiers processed (should equal len(decisions) + len(unresolved) when session completes normally).

fields.name: interrupted
fields.description: True if the session was interrupted (e.g. Ctrl+C) and partial progress was persisted.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the resolution session started.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the resolution session ended (or was interrupted).

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 model summarizing the outcome of a complete identity resolution session. Supports both JSON and YAML serialization.

types.name: IdentityResolutionConfig

fields.name: auto_confirm_threshold
fields.description: Suggestions at or above this confidence are auto-confirmed without user interaction. Maps to --auto-confirm-above CLI flag.

fields.name: unknown_count_threshold
fields.description: When the number of unknown identifiers exceeds this threshold, auto-trigger interactive prompting (if in a TTY). Maps to --unknown-threshold CLI flag.

fields.name: output_path
fields.description: Filesystem path where the YAML unresolved identities file is written in non-interactive mode. Parent directory must exist.

fields.name: interactive
fields.description: When true, use TTY interactive prompts. When false (default), log warnings and write YAML file. Overridden to false if stdout is not a TTY regardless of flag value.

fields.name: context

functions.name: prompt
functions.description: Present an unknown identifier and its match suggestions to the user (or log them in non-interactive mode) and return a resolution decision. This is the core method of the IdentityPrompter protocol. InteractivePrompter: displays formatted TTY prompt 'Who is @handle? Best match: person_id (confidence). Confirm? [y/n/other]'. NonInteractivePrompter: logs a warning and returns a skip decision.

inputs.name: unknown
inputs.description: The unknown identifier to present for resolution.

inputs.name: suggestions
inputs.description: Candidate matches ordered by descending confidence. May be empty if no suggestions are available.

error_cases.name: prompt_io_error
error_cases.condition: Interactive mode and stdin/stdout IO fails (e.g. broken pipe, closed TTY)

error_cases.name: interrupted
error_cases.condition: User sends Ctrl+C (KeyboardInterrupt) during interactive prompt

preconditions: unknown.handle is a non-empty string
suggestions list is sorted by confidence descending
For interactive mode: stdout is a TTY (verified at construction time)
postconditions: Returned ResolutionDecision.unknown == input unknown
If action is 'confirm', resolved_person_id matches a candidate_person_id from suggestions
If action is 'manual', resolved_person_id is a non-empty string not necessarily from suggestions
If action is 'reject' or 'skip', resolved_person_id is null
decided_at is set to current UTC time
side_effects: Interactive mode: writes prompt text to stdout, reads from stdin
Non-interactive mode: writes warning to logger

functions.name: resolve_identity_unknowns
functions.description: Async orchestrator: collects unknown identifiers from the resolver, generates match suggestions, presents each to the prompter (interactive or non-interactive), persists confirmed/manual mappings to AliasStore, and returns a comprehensive ResolutionReport. Handles Ctrl+C gracefully by persisting partial progress. Auto-confirms suggestions above config.auto_confirm_threshold without prompting. In non-interactive mode, writes unresolved identities to YAML at config.output_path.

inputs.name: unknowns
inputs.description: List of unknown identifiers collected from the identity resolver after a run.

inputs.name: suggestion_fn
inputs.description: Callable with signature (handle: str) -> list[MatchSuggestion]. Typically resolver.suggest_match. Returns candidate matches for a given handle.

inputs.name: prompter_mode
inputs.description: Selects the prompter implementation: 'interactive' for TTY prompts, 'non_interactive' for log-and-file.

inputs.name: alias_store
inputs.description: AliasStore protocol implementation for persisting confirmed alias mappings. Must support add_alias(handle: str, person_id: str, source: str) -> None.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration controlling thresholds, output path, and interactive mode.

error_cases.name: store_write_failed
error_cases.condition: AliasStore.add_alias raises an exception during persistence of a confirmed mapping

error_cases.name: yaml_serialization_failed
error_cases.condition: YAML serialization of the unresolved identities file fails (encoding error, invalid data)

error_cases.name: file_write_failed
error_cases.condition: Writing the YAML output file to config.output_path fails (permission denied, disk full, path not found)

error_cases.name: resolver_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The suggestion_fn callable raises an exception when invoked

error_cases.name: config_invalid
error_cases.condition: Config validation fails at runtime (e.g. output_path parent does not exist)

preconditions: unknowns list is not empty (caller should skip invocation if empty)
suggestion_fn is callable and returns list[MatchSuggestion]
alias_store implements the AliasStore protocol (add_alias method)
config.output_path parent directory exists and is writable
If prompter_mode is 'interactive', stdout must be a TTY
postconditions: All confirm/manual decisions have been persisted to alias_store via add_alias
report.total_processed == len(unknowns)
report.auto_confirmed + report.user_confirmed == count of decisions with action in ('confirm', 'manual')
len(report.decisions) + len(report.unresolved) == report.total_processed when report.interrupted is false
In non-interactive mode: YAML file written at config.output_path containing unresolved identities
If interrupted: report.interrupted is true and partial progress was persisted to alias_store and YAML file
report.started_at <= report.completed_at
side_effects: Persists confirmed/manual alias mappings to AliasStore
Writes YAML file at config.output_path in non-interactive mode or on interruption
Logs warnings for all unknown identifiers in non-interactive mode
Reads from stdin and writes to stdout in interactive mode

functions.name: build_config_from_cli
functions.description: Build an IdentityResolutionConfig from parsed CLI flags, applying defaults and TTY safety guard. If interactive mode is requested but stdout is not a TTY, forces non-interactive mode and logs a warning. Merges CLI flag overrides with defaults.

inputs.name: cli_flags
inputs.description: Parsed CLI flags from argparse namespace.

inputs.name: is_tty
inputs.description: Whether stdout is connected to a TTY. Used as safety guard to prevent interactive prompts in CI or piped contexts.

inputs.name: default_output_path
inputs.description: Default filesystem path for YAML output if not specified via CLI flags.

error_cases.name: config_invalid
error_cases.condition: CLI flag values fail validation (e.g. auto_confirm_above outside 0.0-1.0, unknown_threshold < 1)

preconditions: cli_flags is a valid CLIFlags instance
default_output_path is a valid path whose parent directory exists
postconditions: If is_tty is false, returned config.interactive is always false regardless of cli_flags
If cli_flags.auto_confirm_above is not null, config.auto_confirm_threshold equals cli_flags.auto_confirm_above
If cli_flags.unknown_threshold is not null, config.unknown_count_threshold equals cli_flags.unknown_threshold
If cli_flags.output_path is not null, config.output_path equals cli_flags.output_path; otherwise equals default_output_path
side_effects: Logs a warning if interactive mode was requested but stdout is not a TTY

functions.name: serialize_report_to_yaml
functions.description: Serialize a ResolutionReport to a versioned YAML string suitable for writing to the unresolved identities file. The output is mergeable (sorted keys, stable ordering) and idempotent (same input always produces same output).

inputs.name: report
inputs.description: The resolution report to serialize.

error_cases.name: yaml_serialization_failed
error_cases.condition: YAML serialization fails due to unencodable data in the report

preconditions: report is a valid ResolutionReport instance
report.schema_version >= 1
postconditions: Output is valid YAML that can be deserialized back to a ResolutionReport
Output contains a top-level 'schema_version' key
Identical inputs produce byte-identical outputs (deterministic serialization)
Output uses block style for readability, sorted mapping keys

functions.name: deserialize_report_from_yaml
functions.description: Deserialize a YAML string into a ResolutionReport, with schema version migration support. Enables loading previously written unresolved identity files for incremental resolution.

inputs.name: yaml_content
inputs.description: YAML string content to deserialize.

error_cases.name: yaml_deserialization_failed
error_cases.condition: YAML parsing fails or content does not conform to any known schema version

preconditions: yaml_content is valid YAML
yaml_content contains a 'schema_version' key
postconditions: Returned ResolutionReport is valid and fully hydrated
Schema version migration applied if yaml schema_version < current version

functions.name: persist_partial_progress
functions.description: Persist partial resolution progress on interruption (Ctrl+C). Flushes all completed confirm/manual decisions to AliasStore, then writes a PartialProgress snapshot and remaining unknowns as YAML to the configured output path. Called from the Ctrl+C signal handler within resolve_identity_unknowns.

inputs.name: progress
inputs.description: Snapshot of the resolution session at the time of interruption.

inputs.name: alias_store
inputs.description: AliasStore protocol implementation for persisting confirmed alias mappings.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration containing the output_path for YAML file.

error_cases.name: store_write_failed
error_cases.condition: AliasStore write fails during partial flush — best-effort, does not re-raise

error_cases.name: file_write_failed
error_cases.condition: YAML file write fails during partial progress save — best-effort, does not re-raise

preconditions: progress contains only valid decisions
alias_store is available and writable
config.output_path parent directory exists
postconditions: All confirm/manual decisions in progress.completed_decisions are persisted to alias_store
YAML file at config.output_path contains the remaining_unknowns for later resume
Returns true if all persistence operations succeeded, false if any failed (best-effort)
side_effects: Logs errors if persistence fails rather than raising

functions.name: should_auto_trigger_interactive
functions.description: Determine whether the identity resolution should auto-trigger interactive prompting based on the number of unknowns exceeding the configured threshold and TTY availability. Used by the CLI entry point to decide whether to invoke resolve_identity_unknowns even without an explicit --resolve-identities flag.

inputs.name: unknown_count
inputs.description: Number of unknown identifiers found after the resolver run.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration containing the unknown_count_threshold.

inputs.name: is_tty
inputs.description: Whether stdout is a TTY.

postconditions: Returns true only if unknown_count > config.unknown_count_threshold AND is_tty is true
Returns false if is_tty is false regardless of unknown_count

functions.name: register_identity_cli_flags
functions.description: Register identity resolution CLI flags on an argparse ArgumentParser. Adds --resolve-identities (BooleanOptionalAction), --auto-confirm-above (float), --unknown-threshold (int), and --identity-output-path (Path). Called during CLI setup in cli/run_cmd.py.

inputs.name: parser
inputs.description: argparse.ArgumentParser instance to add flags to.

error_cases.name: config_invalid
error_cases.condition: Flag registration fails due to conflicting argument names on the parser

preconditions: parser is a valid argparse.ArgumentParser instance
No conflicting flags already registered on parser
postconditions: parser now accepts --resolve-identities / --no-resolve-identities (BooleanOptionalAction, default false)
parser now accepts --auto-confirm-above (float, optional)
parser now accepts --unknown-threshold (int, optional)
parser now accepts --identity-output-path (Path, optional)
Returns the same parser for chaining
side_effects: Mutates the provided argparse parser by adding argument definitions

functions.name: parse_cli_flags_to_struct
functions.description: Extract identity-resolution-related flags from a parsed argparse.Namespace and return a typed CLIFlags struct. Validates that flag values are within acceptable ranges.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: argparse.Namespace from parser.parse_args().

error_cases.name: config_invalid
error_cases.condition: Namespace contains invalid values for identity resolution flags (e.g. auto_confirm_above > 1.0)

preconditions: namespace was produced by a parser that had register_identity_cli_flags applied
postconditions: All fields in CLIFlags are populated from namespace attributes or set to their defaults
Float and int values have been validated against their ranges

invariants: ResolutionDecision: if action is 'confirm' or 'manual', then resolved_person_id must be a non-empty string
ResolutionDecision: if action is 'reject' or 'skip', then resolved_person_id must be null
ResolutionDecision: if action is 'confirm', then matched_suggestion must not be null and matched_suggestion.candidate_person_id must equal resolved_person_id
ResolutionReport: len(decisions) + len(unresolved) == total_processed when interrupted is false
IdentityResolutionConfig: if interactive is true, the runtime environment must have a TTY on stdout
All datetime fields use UTC timezone
YAML output files always contain a top-level schema_version key
YAML serialization is deterministic: same input produces byte-identical output
Auto-confirm only applies when the best suggestion confidence >= config.auto_confirm_threshold
Non-interactive mode never blocks on stdin; it always logs and skips
Partial progress persistence on Ctrl+C is best-effort: failures are logged, not raised
All Pydantic models are frozen (immutable after construction)
requires: AliasStore protocol: add_alias(handle: str, person_id: str, source: str) -> None
Identity resolver: unknown_identifiers property returning list of unknown handles
PyYAML or ruamel.yaml for YAML serialization
Pydantic v2 for model definitions and validation
